Figure 58 Student Preserved Engagement Levels 
Conversely to the distractibility levels, the proposed application tends towards 
higher self-reported engagement levels, with 90% of responses within the 
engaged to highly engaged range. This distribution indicates the applications 
success in capturing and maintaining student interest through-out the 
investigation. The distribution averages just above “Engaged” for the proposed 
application, highlighting while the application proved effective, it was not 
universally perceived as exceptional by the students, offering room for further 
improvement. 
In contrast, Bitesize shows a significant gravitation towards “Somewhat 
Engaged”, suggesting one of two things. First, Bitesize is on the edge of higher 
engagement levels, but is potentially held back by its lack of gamified or short 
form content features. Second, the presents of a “Somewhat Engaged”, offers a 
safe and unextreme choice for the students; whom may have not found the 
material engaging but where not entirely disinterested. Perhaps for these 
students selecting “Not Engaged” would have been too extreme.
